name: Auroraceratops
sum: Auroraceratops is a basal neoceratopsian from the Early Cretaceous of Gansu, China, with a short, wide snout.
wsnote: Estimate from the 2019 postcranial analysis (cited Wikipedia revision).
holotype: CAGS IG-2004-VD-001, a well-preserved skull found in 2004 — Zhonggou Formation, Gongpoquan Basin, Gansu.
material: Further specimens from the Yujingzi Basin were reassessed as this genus.
biology: Walked bipedally; snout shorter and wider than in most neoceratopsians.
author: You et al. 2005

sources.text: You, H.; Li, D; Ji, Q.; Lamanna, M.C.; Dodson, P. 2005. On a New Genus of Basal Neoceratopsian Dinosaur from the Early Cretaceous of Gansu Province, China. Acta Geologica Sinica 79(5): 593–597.
